newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Great River buys Singapore Disney firm.
newsitem.headline: Great River buys Singapore Disney firm.

text.p: Indonesian clothing company P.T. Great River International said on Wednesday it bought Ray Summers, a private Singapore-based company with a licence to distribute and sell Walt Disney Co's consumer products.
Great River president director Sunjoto Tanudjata told a news conference his company had signed a new licencing agreement with Disney which would be valid for at least 18 months.
He declined to say how much Great River had paid for Ray Summers but said details would be announced to the Jakarta Stock Exchange within one week.
Ray Summers' manager and previous owner Angie Mui said the company's annual turnover was approximately Singapore $10-15 million, almost all of which came from sales of Disney products.
Mui said she hoped Ray Summers, which has one shop in Singapore and distributes to 30 department stores in the city-state, would benefit from the takeover.
"Great River can provide the manufacturing capacity that we need and they are very sucessful in retail markets," she said.
Ray Summers has non-exclusive licences with Disney covering Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand and the Middle East. It also distributes products to Tokyo Disneyland.
